verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents Enterprise-tier 'Private Storage' to store meeting data at a preferred location and 'Secure, dedicated cloud storage exclusively for your organization's data,' directly addressing data residency choice, but this is gated to a specific plan with no detail on which regions are supported or how selection is configured. Missing for 10: list of available regions, self-serve UI/API for setting residency, independent/hands-on confirmation of the feature working as described.
